title: YouTube Group Meeting Sprint Planning Q3

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen
transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's kick off the Q3 sprint planning. We've decided to prioritize the new authentication system over the analytics dashboard this quarter.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: I agree with that decision. Alex Rivera will take ownership of the OAuth 2.0 integration and have it ready for code review by Friday end of day.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Vance
transcript.text: I'm concerned about the timeline. The current database schema doesn't support multi-tenant auth tokens and that could be a serious blocker for the Friday deadline.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen
transcript.text: We need to decide right now — do we roll back the v2.4 release or patch the database schema in place? I strongly recommend we roll back.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: I disagree with the rollback approach. Rolling back v2.4 would take at least 3 hours of downtime. We should apply the missing index migration and patch in place instead.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Vance
transcript.text: Marcus Vance will run the full load test suite against the staging environment and report results before 4 PM today to help us make this decision.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen
transcript.text: Agreed. After reviewing Marcus's load test results, we decided to apply the targeted index patch without rolling back v2.4. That's our final decision.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: There's also a dependency risk — the mobile team's SDK version 3.1 is not compatible with the new mTLS certificate rotation we're planning. That needs to be resolved first.
